_about: Iso movement (iso/scripts/iso_player.gd). Speeds are matched to the clips' own ground speed (iso/tools/measure_gait.gd: walk 0.82 m/s, run 3.02 m/s, walk_hurt 1.17 m/s), so playback = speed / clip speed and the feet never slide. Outside the walls the default gait is a run; inside the caravanserai (calm zones) it is a walk, and Shift / the left trigger swaps them.
